blocks.text: Former Taiwan President Tsai Ing-we said on Friday she will visit the United States next week to deliver a speech at a technology and national security conference at Stanford University. Tsai said in her social media posts that she will attend the Stanford DEFCON 2026 Technology & National Security Conference on Wednesday during her first visit to the country since leaving office in 2024.
